meta.description: Sandbox process provider extension: adds the authorized extra roots to the sandbox runner's write allow-list. On Linux it appends --bind to bwrap; on macOS it appends allow rules to the sandbox-exec Seatbelt profile — either way no approval is needed. The Linux landlock rung cannot be extended and ignores extra roots with a one-time warning. On Windows the stock ACL sandbox stays active, so this row does nothing. Replaces the stock sandbox row on Linux/macOS.
